scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/precompress.mjs dist && node scripts/build-sitemap.mjs dist && node scripts/write-asset-manifest.mjs dist
scripts.build:stage: tsc -b && vite build --outDir dist.stage && node scripts/precompress.mjs dist.stage && node scripts/build-sitemap.mjs dist.stage && node scripts/write-asset-manifest.mjs dist.stage
scripts.build:check: tsc -b && vite build --outDir dist.check && node scripts/precompress.mjs dist.check && node scripts/build-sitemap.mjs dist.check && node scripts/write-asset-manifest.mjs dist.check
scripts.e2e: npm run build:check && playwright test e2e/hermetic.spec.ts e2e/visitor.spec.ts
